referencia: Prévia de seis avatares aprovada pelo usuário em 2026-10-08
entrega: web/public/avatares/*.webp — 512 × 512, otimizados a partir das imagens geradas

prompts.ursinho: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied six-avatar concept sheet. Create ONE standalone square profile-avatar asset featuring ONLY the top left teddy bear with sage bow, pale sage backdrop. Preserve the selected subject's exact children's-book watercolor/gouache art style, face, colors and character design from the reference. Remove ALL the other avatars and all text, labels, title and sheet layout. The chosen character must be large, centered, immediately recognizable as a tiny 36px circular profile avatar, inside a circular vignette occupying nearly the entire square. Keep its face, ears, bow and defining features inside the circle (especially bunny ears); no clipped features. Keep a soft cream #F7F5EE square background outside the circle. Muted sage #4F6B57 and gentle ivory/ochre palette consistent with the reference. No new subjects, no letters, no labels, no watermark. Finished asset for the Enxoval Inteligente app.
